nodes.text: India has reported a total of 15 cases of human metapneumovirus (HMPV), with 6 cases in Gujarat, 4 in Karnataka, 3 in Maharashtra, and 2 in Tamil Nadu. The Union Health Ministry has stated that the situation is under control, with no unusual surge in cases. https://t.co/nffSeG1jCM
